bfold_colouring.note: bfold_colouring b f: the supplied map f : G -> {set 'I_a} gives every vertex a b-element set of colours from the supplied palette 'I_a and adjacent vertices disjoint sets, the standard (a:b)-colouring; b = 0 and an empty vertex type are allowed without a guard, a vertex forces b <= a and an edge 2 * b <= a. No ratio a/b is part of it: fractional-chromatic consumers carry their own 0 < b.
